purpose: Inspect every frozen V27 development trade to determine whether a simple causal failure-recognition pattern can reduce downside before any later exposure experiment. This is an optimization anatomy of an existing strategy, not a new high-recall mother and not independent validation.

development_corpus.later_trade_rows_policy: Query only signal dates through 2020-12-31. Do not use 2021-2023 trade outcomes during chart-rule compression.

chart_contract.window: 126 market sessions before through 126 market sessions after the signal, capped at 2021-06-30
panels: action-coordinate daily candles normalized to signal close
chart_contract.review_order: all chronological sheets first, then complete outcome-group contradiction sheets

allowed_roles: entry veto only if visible before the frozen entry
requirements: Every rule must have an economic supply-demand interpretation.
Every rule must use only information available by its decision close.
No threshold, day-count, target, stop, lane, or market-state grid.
Direct visual counterexamples must be recorded.
Do not combine rules until each has a distinct mechanism.
rule_compression.post_review_sequence: Freeze at most five exact causal rules, then run one one-shot development replay. No rescue after the result.

success_question: Can a chart-derived causal failure rule materially reduce V27 drawdown and severe losses while preserving enough return that a separately frozen higher-utilization test could plausibly double annualized return without worsening the original drawdown?
